 Honourable Sri Justice C.V. Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition Nos.22523 And 22689 Of 2015
Common Order:

entities.text: Cherukuri Upender Rao vs Food Safety And Standards Authority
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: to as mentioned in W.P.No.22523 of 2015.

3. The case of the petitioner is that without issuing any notice and without following the procedure contemplated under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, (for short 'the Act') 2006,
the respondents are frequently interfering with his business activities and causing inconvenience for manufacturing and distribution of the flavored drinking water.

4. Ms. Hamsini, learned counsel appearing for respondent No.1, on instructions, would submit that respondent No.1 will initiate appropriate action against the petitioner, if it is found that the petitioner is carrying on his business activities, contrary to the provisions of the Act.
5. In view of the above submissions made by the learned counsel for respondent No.1, these writ petitions are closed.
However, the respondents are at liberty to take appropriate action against the petitioners, if the petitioners are manufacturing the flavored drinking water without necessary permissions.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous Petitions, if any, pending in these writ petitions shall stand closed.

C.V. BHASKAR REDDY, J Date: 12.07.2024 sus Cherukuri Upender Rao vs Food Safety And Standards Authority Of ... on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98980212/
